round_intro_zh:
小组赛第二轮全面打响。首轮已让本轮的六分战和出线生死战全部摆上台面：A 组 Mexico vs South Korea——两支首轮全胜的队伍正面碰撞，谁先摸到 16 强门票？B 组四队齐平 1 分，瑞士 vs 波黑、加拿大 vs 卡塔尔，赢者立刻占得先机。

本周 16 场必看里，最不能错过的有 4 场：Mexico vs South Korea（A 组头名之争，本周最关键）、England vs Ghana（欧洲新王 vs 非洲劲旅，英格兰的真正考验）、Argentina vs Austria（卫冕冠军首战）、Germany vs Ivory Coast（德国首战，对手是非洲杯冠军）。
round_intro_en:
Matchday 2 is here and the stakes are suddenly real. Eight teams opened with wins and the second-leg matchups are now six-pointers: Mexico vs South Korea in Group A, plus a four-way logjam in Group B where Switzerland, Bosnia, Canada, and Qatar are all level on 1pt. Heavyweights England, Germany, Spain, France, and Argentina all face mid-tier opposition this round — a slip here shakes the group standings before MD3 even arrives.

Of the 16 must-watch games this week, four you really can't miss: Mexico–South Korea (Thu 8 PM CT, top of Group A), England–Ghana (Tue 3 PM CT, the Three Lions' first real test), Argentina–Austria (Tue 12 PM CT, the world champions against a crafty European side), and Germany–Ivory Coast (Sun 3 PM CT, a tricky opener for the Germans against the Africa Cup of Nations holders).
